description: Fetch specific chunks by chunk_id to read the exact source text for a citation, or to follow an outgoing reference (resolved_chunk_id) from another chunk. A fragmented section/article is completed with up to two continuation chunks automatically. Ids outside the given contexts/documents are not returned (reported in missing_ids). A chunk that runs onto another PDF page has `page_end`, and its text marks each page change with a line [p. N]: cite the page of the sentence you quote (text before the first mark is on `page`).

document_ids.description: Optional: restrict to these documents (ids from list_documents); they must belong to the given contexts.

name: get_chunks
